281500820.description: This is a raw mineral specimen featuring calcite druzy on a basalt matrix. The specimen measures 3.75x2.75x2.5 inches and displays clusters of clear to white cubic calcite crystals on a black to dark gray basalt rock. The surface is rough and natural with well-formed crystal formations throughout. The specimen weighs 13.8 ounces and is unpolished, in its natural state. It is suitable for collectors or educational use.
